gloss: the period right after a vacation; post-vacation

definitions.gloss: the period right after a vacation; post-vacation
definitions.explanation: the time immediately after returning from a holiday or time off

examples.japanese: {休暇明|きゅうかあ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つらい。
examples.english: Work is tough right after vacation.

examples.japanese: {休暇明|きゅうかあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たまって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A huge number of emails had piled up when I came back from vacation.

examples.japanese: {長期|ちょうき}{休暇明|きゅうかあ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: After a long vacation, it takes time to get back into your routine.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧ (vacation, time off) + ⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ (the period after something ends). The ⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ suffix is productive and attaches to various nouns to indicate the period immediately following: {正月明|しょうがつあ}け (after New Year's), ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧ (after the rainy season), ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧ (dawn, after night).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休暇明|きゅうかあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧: the Monday after vacation
- {長期|ちょうき}{休暇明|きゅうかあ}け: after a long vacation
- {休暇明|きゅうかあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出社|しゅっしゃ}→出社：06155_shussha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go to work after vacation
- {休暇明|きゅうかあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{憂鬱|ゆううつ}→憂鬱：05821_yuuutsu⟧: post-vacation blues

RELATED PATTERNS WITH {明|あ}け:
- {正月明|しょうがつあ}け: after the New Year holiday
- ⟦{連休明|れんきゅうあ}け→連休明け：17704_renkyuuake⟧: after a consecutive holiday period
- {盆明|ぼんあ}け: after the Obon holiday
- GW⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧: after Golden Week
